messages.author: 42eed4e1caba0ad0
messages.subject: Integrating Rook with nginx
parts:
Hi there,

I'm aware of the fact that Rook is more flexible than RApache, since it can interact with any webserver (in theory). So far, I've been using it with internal web-server only (so-called: Rhttpd). I'm working on a project where PHP scripts will be served with nginx, and surely I can send RPC to R scripts relying on (R)Apache, it's just that... it's a bit more elegant to use only one server. And with nginx, I guess it's also a bit faster... I guess that integrating Rook with nginx shouldn't be too cumbersome to achieve, so... did anyone of you guys manage to get it working, and if so, how did you do it?

Cheers!

--
aL3xa
